name: Airtable
product_scope: Web API for base records and metadata; Enterprise admin functions are separate.
minimum_plan: Free, Team, Business and Enterprise Scale
plan_notes: Core Web API is available on all plans. Monthly allowances: Free 1,000; Team 100,000; Business/Enterprise no monthly call cap, still rate limited.
webhook_notes: Webhooks API notifies about changes to base records, fields and view membership. It is distinct from incoming automation webhooks.
authentication_notes: Token scopes and selected bases must match the user’s permissions. Legacy user API keys no longer work.
limitations: 5 requests/second per base on all pricing tiers; list responses are paginated at up to 100 records.
ai_use_case_editorial: Categorise incoming requests and suggest values for an operations table.

name: Asana
product_scope: Tasks/projects REST API; premium resource features retain their plan requirements.
minimum_plan: Free and paid accounts
plan_notes: Free accounts can use the API. Paid-only product features are not unlocked by having a developer token.
webhook_notes: Task/project webhooks use an HTTPS receiver and handshake; events remain tied to the creating user/token’s access.
authentication_notes: PATs inherit user permissions. Use OAuth for apps acting for other users; view-only users have limited API access.
limitations: 150 requests/minute on free domains; 1,500 on paid domains, per token. Search and concurrent operations have additional limits.
ai_use_case_editorial: Extract proposed actions from an approved brief and create tasks after review.

name: BigChange
product_scope: Modern REST API. Legacy JobWatch Web Services and DaaS are different products.
minimum_plan: REST API licence; confirm contract
plan_notes: The usage policy says REST API access is priced on usage and refers to the customer’s licence details. A universal included subscription tier is not established.
webhook_notes: Native outbound webhooks were not established from the REST reference and usage policy reviewed. Confirm supported event delivery with BigChange before promising real-time sync.
authentication_notes: Register an application, exchange client ID/secret for a bearer token, and send the customer-id header. Endpoint scopes are required.
limitations: Requests can receive 429 and Retry-After; exact allowance is governed by the REST API licence. Reads can lag behind writes because the API is eventually consistent.
ai_use_case_editorial: Prepare a contact briefing for a field-service team from authorised customer records.

name: ClickUp
product_scope: Public API v2, plus separately documented v3 endpoints.
minimum_plan: All ClickUp plans
plan_notes: Public API is available on all plans. User/guest management endpoints and some parameters require Enterprise or other higher tiers.
webhook_notes: API-created subscriptions cover selected Workspace events and locations; webhook delivery follows the creating user’s access.
authentication_notes: Personal tokens for own use; OAuth for apps other people use. Both are permission constrained.
limitations: Per-token requests/minute: Free Forever/Unlimited/Business 100; Business Plus 1,000; Enterprise/Enterprise Plus 10,000. | If the webhook’s creating user is disabled, it stops triggering. Verify signed events and handle duplicates.
ai_use_case_editorial: Draft task descriptions and suggest due dates from approved client requests.

name: FreeAgent
product_scope: Company API v2. Accountancy Practice API uses separate app access.
minimum_plan: FreeAgent company account; exact commercial plan not confirmed
plan_notes: Official developer guidance requires a FreeAgent account and sufficient user access. It does not establish a separate minimum paid API tier in the pages reviewed.
webhook_notes: No native outbound webhook facility was established in the reviewed company API documentation. Invoices support updated_since for polling; this is not proof that webhooks are unavailable.
authentication_notes: Register an app; obtain user consent and maintain access/refresh tokens. Resource access follows the authorised user’s access level.
limitations: 120 requests/minute and 3,600/hour per user; 15 token refreshes/minute. Lists are paginated, with at most 100 items/page.
ai_use_case_editorial: Summarise overdue invoices and prepare follow-up drafts for review.

name: Freshdesk
product_scope: Freshdesk support API v2; not Freshsales or a blanket statement about Freshdesk Omni.
minimum_plan: Growth, Pro or Enterprise for current API quotas
plan_notes: The current support table lists Free at 0 API calls; Growth 100/minute, Pro 400, Enterprise 700. Legacy accounts and trials can differ.
webhook_notes: Ticket-update automation rules can call webhooks. Entitlement depends on the account generation and automation features; the reviewed guide lists Growth/Pro/Enterprise.
authentication_notes: Authenticate with the agent’s API key over HTTPS. The agent’s role determines allowed operations.
limitations: Limits are account-wide, with additional endpoint caps; invalid requests also consume quota. Use the Freshdesk domain, not a custom CNAME. | Automation webhook callbacks have a documented 1,000/hour limit; excess requests are buffered.
ai_use_case_editorial: Categorise a ticket and propose a priority and reply for a support agent.

name: Google Workspace
product_scope: Google Drive API as the documented example. Gmail, Calendar and Sheets have separate APIs and quotas.
minimum_plan: Account with access to the relevant Google Drive files
plan_notes: Standard Drive API usage is currently available without an additional API charge. Workspace feature entitlements and administrator policies still apply; this entry does not establish access to every Workspace API.
webhook_notes: Drive files/changes can send HTTPS push notifications. A notification signals a change; retrieve the current resource through the API.
authentication_notes: Scopes determine file access. Prefer drive.file for files explicitly used by the app; broader restricted scopes may require additional verification.
limitations: Drive quotas changed for new projects from 1 May 2026; some existing projects retain earlier quotas. Check the project quota instead of assuming a universal request count. | Watch channels expire: up to 1 day for files and 1 week for changes; renew them.
ai_use_case_editorial: Find approved project documents and draft an answer with links back to the originals.

name: HubSpot
product_scope: CRM APIs and app event subscriptions. Workflow webhook actions are a separate feature.
minimum_plan: Free and paid tiers for core APIs
plan_notes: Free/Starter, Professional and Enterprise have documented private-app quotas. Access to a particular object or premium feature still depends on the account subscription and scopes.
webhook_notes: Project-based apps can subscribe to CRM events. Service Keys do not support webhooks; use an app with webhook support.
authentication_methods: OAuth 2.0 | App static token | Service Key
authentication_notes: OAuth for distributed apps; scoped static credentials for a single account. Service Keys are described as public beta and require Developer Tools access.
limitations: Private apps on Free/Starter: 100 requests/10 seconds per app and 250,000/day shared by the account. Search and other APIs have separate limits.
ai_use_case_editorial: Draft a contact summary and propose CRM property updates after a meeting.

name: Jira Cloud
product_scope: Jira Cloud platform REST API v3. Jira Data Center is outside this entry.
minimum_plan: Jira Cloud site; minimum paid edition not established
plan_notes: API access follows scopes, project permissions and app access policies. The reviewed references do not establish a separate minimum paid edition for core issue operations.
webhook_notes: Issue/comment events can be delivered to webhook endpoints. REST-registered dynamic webhooks for OAuth apps expire after 30 days unless renewed.
authentication_methods: OAuth 2.0 (3LO) | API token via HTTP Basic | Forge app scopes
authentication_notes: Use OAuth for third-party integrations. Personal scripts can use email plus an API token; access remains limited by the user’s permissions.
limitations: Since March 2026, Forge/Connect/OAuth apps use points-based and tiered quotas as well as burst/per-issue limits. API-token traffic retains existing burst limits. | OAuth apps can register 5 dynamic webhooks per app/user/tenant. Renew expiring registrations and implement supported event filters.
ai_use_case_editorial: Summarise a project issue and draft an update or new issue from approved support notes.

name: Klaviyo
product_scope: Server-side Profiles/Lists/Events APIs and system webhooks. Flow webhooks are distinct.
minimum_plan: Account with API permissions; Advanced KDP/app partner for system webhooks
plan_notes: Core API key access is role/scope based. System Webhooks API is restricted to Advanced KDP customers and Klaviyo app partners; do not assume a normal email plan includes it.
webhook_notes: System webhooks cover supported email/SMS/push/review/consent events. Flow webhooks are separately configured actions.
authentication_notes: Use scoped private keys or OAuth for server-side data. Public site IDs are only for the client-side API, not secure profile retrieval.
limitations: At most 10 system webhooks per account; activation can take up to 3 minutes. OAuth app webhooks are scoped to that app.
ai_use_case_editorial: Enrich approved customer profile attributes for segmentation while preserving consent.

name: Mailchimp
product_scope: Marketing API v3. Transactional email is a separate product.
minimum_plan: Mailchimp account; operation-specific plan entitlement
plan_notes: The developer overview requires an account but does not establish one minimum paid tier for all operations. Sending, automation and audience limits remain plan dependent.
webhook_notes: Audience webhooks can notify about subscription/profile/email changes and campaign sending. Not every analytics event is an audience webhook.
authentication_notes: API keys for your own account; OAuth for integrations installed by third parties. Credentials are bounded by the authorising user’s role.
limitations: Marketing API: 10 simultaneous connections per user and a 120-second timeout. Batch requests have additional queue limits.
ai_use_case_editorial: Suggest audience tags from approved CRM attributes without changing marketing consent.

name: Microsoft 365
product_scope: Microsoft Graph: Outlook mail/calendar and SharePoint/OneDrive files. Other Graph products may have different licensing.
minimum_plan: Licence for the underlying Microsoft 365 workload
plan_notes: There is no single plan entitlement covering every Graph API. Verify the Exchange, SharePoint or other workload licence and endpoint requirements for the tenant.
webhook_notes: Graph change notifications support selected resources including Outlook messages/events and drive items; subscriptions expire and need renewal.
authentication_notes: Delegated access acts for a user; application permissions act without one and generally require admin consent. Request only the scopes for the workload.
limitations: Outlook supports at most 1,000 active subscriptions per mailbox across all apps. Shared-folder notifications require the appropriate application permission. | Handle subscription expiry and lifecycle events; do not assume a notification subscription is permanent.
ai_use_case_editorial: Draft a meeting briefing from authorised calendar and mailbox content.

name: monday.com
product_scope: Platform GraphQL API; API-created webhooks are separate from automation recipes.
minimum_plan: Free, Basic, Standard, Pro and Enterprise
plan_notes: The platform API is documented as a free feature across plans. Daily allowances vary; individual product features may still be gated.
webhook_notes: The create_webhook mutation subscribes to supported board/item events. The receiver must answer a verification challenge.
authentication_notes: Personal tokens mirror the user’s board, item and column permissions. App integrations can use OAuth tokens.
limitations: Daily calls: 1,000 on Free/Basic/Standard; 10,000 Pro; 25,000 Enterprise. Complexity, minute and concurrency budgets apply separately.
ai_use_case_editorial: Classify an incoming work request and propose an item with status and owner.

name: Notion
product_scope: Notion public content API; administrative APIs have separate scope.
minimum_plan: Free and paid workspaces
plan_notes: The API has quotas for all plans. Business/Enterprise receive higher connection limits; workspace content limits still apply.
webhook_notes: Connections can receive page, database and other supported change events. Payloads identify changes; fetch content separately.
authentication_methods: Internal connection token | Personal access token | OAuth 2.0
authentication_notes: Internal connections need pages shared with them; public connections use OAuth. PATs act with their creator’s workspace permissions.
limitations: Per connection: 180 requests/minute on other plans and 600/minute on Business/Enterprise. A separate shared workspace budget and endpoint limits also apply. | Maximum request payload: 1,000 block elements and 500 KB; respect Retry-After on throttling.
ai_use_case_editorial: Turn approved meeting notes into draft project pages and action lists.

name: Pipedrive
product_scope: Core CRM API and Webhooks v2.
minimum_plan: Lite, Growth, Premium and Ultimate
plan_notes: API access is available to account users by default, but admins can restrict personal API-token access. Plan/seat counts set the token budget.
webhook_notes: Create/change/delete subscriptions for supported CRM objects. Webhook delivery respects the associated user’s permissions.
authentication_notes: OAuth is required for Marketplace apps. Personal API tokens use the user’s account permissions.
limitations: Burst limits vary by plan and authentication type; Lite personal tokens allow 20 requests/2 seconds. Daily token budgets count endpoint costs, not just HTTP requests.
ai_use_case_editorial: Summarise a deal and suggest a next action based on approved CRM information.

name: QuickBooks Online
product_scope: QuickBooks Online Accounting REST API. Desktop and Self-Employed are outside this entry.
minimum_plan: QuickBooks Online company plus Intuit app access; minimum UK plan unconfirmed
plan_notes: The reviewed developer pages establish company authorisation and developer-tier quotas, but not a universal minimum UK business subscription. Check the feature entitlement in the target company.
webhook_notes: Entity-change webhooks include invoices and customers. Production and sandbox subscriptions are configured separately and require the company to authorise the app.
authentication_notes: Connect each company through OAuth. Validate incoming webhook signatures with the app-specific verifier token.
limitations: 500 requests/minute per realm and 10/second per realm and app. Builder has 500,000 included CorePlus calls per workspace/month; higher usage depends on the developer programme. | Progress invoicing is not supported by the invoice API. Do not treat every UI feature as an API capability.
ai_use_case_editorial: Summarise invoice status and prepare proposed line descriptions for an accountant to approve.

name: Sage Accounting
product_scope: Sage Business Cloud Accounting API v3.1 for UK businesses. Sage 50 and Sage Intacct are separate products.
minimum_plan: Accounting Start for sales invoices; Standard/Plus for more features
plan_notes: Sage documents API differences between Start, Standard and Plus. Purchase invoice and product writes require the relevant higher-tier feature; inventory and multicurrency are Plus features.
webhook_notes: Native outbound webhooks were not established in the reviewed Accounting guides. Confirm event delivery before designing real-time synchronisation.
authentication_notes: A user grants readonly or full_access. Use X-Business to select the business; otherwise the lead business is used.
limitations: Access tokens last 5 minutes; refresh tokens last 31 days and must be rotated from the refresh response. | A draft does not post to the accounts. Marking an invoice paid requires a payment/allocation, not a direct status update.
ai_use_case_editorial: Prepare draft sales invoices from approved work records, with accounting review before release.

name: Salesforce
product_scope: Salesforce REST API and Change Data Capture; not a guarantee for every Salesforce product.
minimum_plan: Enterprise, Unlimited, Performance; Professional with API add-on
plan_notes: Developer Edition also includes API access for development. The organisation and the user must both have API access enabled. Confirm entitlements on newer or negotiated editions.
webhook_notes: Change Data Capture publishes create/update/delete/undelete events through a subscription stream. This is an event-stream option, not a generic outbound HTTP webhook.
authentication_notes: An authorised app and user permissions govern access; object and field permissions still apply.
limitations: CDC is documented for Enterprise, Performance, Unlimited and Developer editions. Event delivery allocations and API request allowances must be checked for the organisation.
ai_use_case_editorial: Create a reviewable opportunity summary from the account and its recent activity.

name: Shopify
product_scope: GraphQL Admin API. Storefront API is a separate surface.
minimum_plan: Shopify store with an installed, authorised app
plan_notes: Standard plans have a GraphQL Admin quota; Advanced/Plus/enterprise have higher quotas. Access to protected customer fields and specialised APIs has separate requirements.
webhook_notes: App event subscriptions can deliver order/product and other supported topics over HTTPS. Scopes and protected-data approval affect payloads.
authentication_notes: An installed app uses an Admin API access token and approved access scopes. Custom app creation/distribution rules must also be checked.
limitations: GraphQL Admin restore rates: Standard 100 cost points/second; Advanced 200; Plus 1,000. A single query may not exceed 1,000 points. | Unapproved protected customer fields can be redacted; API access alone does not establish permission to retrieve personal data.
ai_use_case_editorial: Draft product descriptions from approved product data for a merchandiser to review.

name: Slack
product_scope: Web API and outbound Events API. Incoming webhooks only post into Slack.
minimum_plan: Free and paid workspaces, subject to app permissions and retention
plan_notes: API rate tiers apply across Slack plans. Available message history and app installation controls still depend on the workspace.
webhook_notes: Events API delivers authorised events to an HTTP endpoint or Socket Mode. Incoming webhooks are a different, write-into-Slack feature.
authentication_notes: Scopes and channel membership limit visibility. An app cannot read every private channel merely because it is installed.
limitations: New commercially distributed non-Marketplace apps have stricter history/replies limits; internal customer-built apps keep the documented Tier 3 history limit. | Events API limit: 30,000 deliveries per workspace, app and hour.
ai_use_case_editorial: Summarise an opted-in project channel and post a reviewable weekly update.

name: Trello
product_scope: Trello REST API; not Atlassian Jira APIs.
minimum_plan: Trello account; minimum paid tier not established
plan_notes: The reviewed developer pages describe API-key/token access without establishing a minimum paid subscription. Board features and permissions still apply.
webhook_notes: Model-change webhooks are bound to a token and can observe only models it can access.
authentication_notes: Use authorisation for the relevant user and boards. Current webhook documentation also describes OAuth 2.0 bearer tokens.
limitations: 300 requests/10 seconds per API key and 100/10 seconds per token. The members endpoint has an additional limit.
ai_use_case_editorial: Draft task cards and labels from approved project notes.

name: WooCommerce
product_scope: Self-hosted WooCommerce REST API v3; Store API has different access and limits.
minimum_plan: Core WooCommerce; no separate API subscription
plan_notes: The REST API is part of WooCommerce. A working WordPress/WooCommerce site and hosting are required; extensions may add their own paid features.
webhook_notes: Core webhooks cover order, product, customer and coupon events. Manage them in Advanced settings or the API.
authentication_notes: Use HTTPS and a key with read, write or read/write permission. Access follows the associated WordPress user’s capabilities.
limitations: Requires compatible WordPress/WooCommerce versions and non-default permalinks. Host configuration can affect auth headers and allowed HTTP methods. | Webhook delivery can fail or be disabled after repeated failures; monitor deliveries and verify the signature.
ai_use_case_editorial: Prepare product-copy changes or a customer-service order summary for approval.

name: Xero
product_scope: Accounting API; UK business organisation. Payroll and Practice Manager are outside this entry.
minimum_plan: Xero organisation + developer tier
plan_notes: Developer Starter supports up to 5 connections. A sixth requires Core. These developer tiers are separate from the business accounting subscription; confirm the organisation supports the intended feature.
webhook_notes: App webhooks cover selected events, including contact and invoice creation/updates; not every Accounting API object.
authentication_notes: Use an authorised Xero organisation and the necessary accounting scopes. Request offline_access for ongoing webhook access beyond the initial token lifetime.
limitations: Current developer FAQ: 1,000 calls/day per organisation on Starter; 5,000 on higher tiers. Also 60/minute and 5 concurrent calls per connection. Older limits FAQs still show 5,000 without the Starter distinction. | Journals and Practice Manager require Advanced tier plus approval; they are not implied by basic Accounting API access.
ai_use_case_editorial: Prepare draft invoice descriptions from approved job notes, with a person checking the invoice before issue.

name: Zendesk
product_scope: Zendesk Support API and webhooks; Chat and other products have separate limits.
minimum_plan: Support Team and higher; Suite quotas vary
plan_notes: Support Team API quota is documented. Suite plan allowances differ from standalone Support; check which product the account uses.
webhook_notes: Support events and ticket triggers can send HTTP requests to configured endpoints; a webhook is not a subscription to every possible field change.
authentication_notes: OAuth access tokens are supported. Zendesk says all API tokens stop working on 30 April 2027; use OAuth for new builds.
limitations: Support Team: 200 requests/minute; Professional 400; Enterprise 700. Some endpoints have stricter limits. | Trial accounts: at most 10 webhooks and 60 invocations/minute.
ai_use_case_editorial: Draft a support reply using the ticket and approved help content, ready for agent review.

name: Zoho CRM
product_scope: Zoho CRM API v8; workflow webhooks and API notifications are distinct mechanisms.
minimum_plan: Free and paid editions for core API
plan_notes: Free has an API credit allowance. Workflow webhook actions are documented for Professional and higher; do not infer their availability from core API access.
webhook_notes: Outbound workflow webhooks require the applicable workflow entitlement. Check the separate Notifications API for supported record-change subscriptions.
authentication_notes: Use a token with module/action scopes and the appropriate data-centre API domain. User permissions still apply.
limitations: Free: 5,000 API credits in a rolling 24 hours and 5 concurrent calls. Paid credits/concurrency vary by edition. Insert/update/upsert requests allow up to 100 records.
ai_use_case_editorial: Classify an enquiry, propose a lead record and route it to the right sales team.
